skills.name: Faith
lines: Target a single party member (or leftmost member is targeted). Give them Promised Blessing stack.
* Promised Blessing: add SPR/2 of caster to all stats of target (except HP/MP) (SPR Limit: 600)
** Stat increase value is defined by pre-battle SPR.
** Effects on game mechanics:
*** Lunatic - Sacrifice is not affected by +END\+SPR parts from stack
*** Base Damage: +STATS increase STAT_stacks parts of damage.
**** SPD damage is affected greater than PWR or INT damage
*** Both direct damage and skill multipliers non-standard stats scaling are affected (Radica AS, Cynthia, Heena...)
* Replaces the basic attack when user possesses Faith stacks and not in Another Force.
* When used - consume 1 Faith.
